benchmark.name: OfficeBench
benchmark.note: OfficeBench has no PowerPoint app. The single-app probe uses Word, Excel and PDF instead; this is recorded so the plan cannot silently claim PowerPoint coverage.

selection.reason: Validate the container, action mapping and evaluator on file-based single-app tasks before cross-app workflows.

tasks.task: Add the sentence "This is a test sentence for task 1-15-0." to the end of house_creak.docx.
Create a new word file called random_paragraph.docx and add the content in random_paragraph.txt to it.
Calculate the average of two midterm scores and write it in the bottom row of the score excel file with header 'Average'.
Sort students' scores descending by midterm1 and save as a new excel file named sorted_score.xlsx.
Extract the title and authors of the paper from the pdf and save them in a word file named paper.docx.

probe.pass: All three arms complete all five tasks and the evaluator scores all five.
probe.gate: After the probe: continue / change benchmark / stop.
